integrity: General proof by exact local inequalities and parity/low-magnetization classification; finite exhaustive verification n=2..8 is a check, not the all-n proof. Same-model review only; no independent audit or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous unit-weight static two-action anti-coordination on K_{n,n} minus t vertex-disjoint bipartite edges, n>=2 and 1<=t<=n; weak pure Nash equilibria include ties. Not arbitrary edge deletions, mixed strategies, random or asynchronous dynamic equilibrium selection, or weighted games. Priority risk remains for unindexed equivalents.
title: Sharp deletion threshold and complete stable-cut census for matching-deleted bicliques
